summary: ConfirmedEditAll is an ASP.NET user control for managing and editing student enrollments in bulk. It provides a grid-based interface for editing actual hours, notes, shifts, and related data for each student, with business rules, validation, calculation, access control, and navigation logic. The control supports saving edits for all students, navigating through sets of records, filtering and sorting entries, and integrates multiple fields and actors for workflow execution.
purpose: To facilitate bulk editing of confirmed student enrollments, including hours, notes, and shift information, while enforcing business rules, validations, and access controls within an educational program enrollment system.

workflows.name: Bulk Enrollment Edit
steps: On loading, set up input parameters from properties and session info.
Check screen access: screen is editable only if record is not waived, graduated, or inactive, and not read-only.
For each row, display actual hours, notes, and shift fields if editable and confirmed.
Provide calculations for shift length and duration shifts.
Hide or show 'Save All' and navigation buttons based on context and row count.
On 'Save All' or 'Save Edit Next' command, validate and save only dirty rows (changed rows).
Redirect after saving based on command to Enrollment or EnrollmentEditAll pages with appropriate query strings.
On prerender, disable edit fields if read-only and set up JavaScript variable declarations for client-side interaction.

business_rules: Rows are editable if not waived, graduated, or inactive, and if screen is not read-only.
The Save logic only applies to rows marked as dirty.
Actual hours can be set to -99 if input is empty.
Shift length is calculated from PlacementRequestDestination or shift code pattern if not explicitly provided.
Save/Cancel/Navigation buttons are hidden or shown based on enrollment context and grid row count.
validations: Notes text area is limited to 200 characters.
Actual hours input validated as decimal; defaults to -99 if empty.
Shift length parsed from code if not directly available.
Only confirmable placements show shift/duration fields.
calculations: Duration shifts calculated as ActualHours / shiftlength.
Shiftlength parsed from code or PlacementRequestDestination record.
Actual hours validated and converted for further use.
conditions: Screen editable if record is not waived, graduated, inactive, and not read-only.
Fields shown or hidden depending on confirmed status and editability.
Save All button hidden in header if only single edit or fewer than 14 rows.
system_behavior: Bulk edit with navigation (Save All/Save Edit Next) based on user commands.
Automatically disables fields if user is in read-only mode.
Dynamically binds grid based on enrollment context and filters.
Integrates with session and program context for filtering and saving.
Handles client-side JavaScript for dirty row tracking and locale settings.
dependencies: Codes lookup for shift code parsing.
UserSession for access and locale settings.
GridView and ObjectDataSource controls for UI and data binding.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data selection is cancelled.
If saving fails (warnings exist in UserSession.Messages), saving stops.
